label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.page: Fashion Web Store (home and category pages)
findings.problem: No skip link or shortcut: every new page restarts focus at the top, and I had to Tab through about 20 header and menu items to reach the first product link, then again on the product page and on the cart page.
Pressing Enter on the T-shirts menu link only opened a Men/Women submenu without going to the category, and the submenu was not announced.
A text field called Value and an unlabeled search button sit before the product list, so the field purpose is unclear.
Reaching Add to cart by keyboard took about 30 Tab presses, passing several links with no accessible name (gallery or social icons) and footer links when going backwards.
The T-shirt size options were never reached by keyboard and I could not tell if size S was preselected; Add to cart worked but I did not choose a size knowingly.

Header navigation has to be tabbed through again (about 17 Tab presses) to reach Checkout, and there was no remove-item button reachable between quantity and Apply coupon; Clear cart sits right before Checkout, a risky neighbour.

On the checkout Address page the first Tab stops were an unnamed icon link, Sign in and the Address step link before reaching the Email field, and the long form (billing and shipping address) could not be completed in the remaining step budget.

findings.page: Fashion Web Store (home and category pages)
findings.problem: No skip link or shortcut: every new page restarts focus at the top, and I had to Tab through about 20 header and menu items to reach the first product link, then again on the product page and on the cart page.
Pressing Enter on the T-shirts menu link only opened a Men/Women submenu without going to the category, and the submenu was not announced.
A text field called Value and an unlabeled search button sit before the product list, so the field purpose is unclear.
Reaching Add to cart by keyboard took about 30 Tab presses, passing several links with no accessible name (gallery or social icons) and footer links when going backwards.
The T-shirt size options were never reached by keyboard and I could not tell if size S was preselected; Add to cart worked but I did not choose a size knowingly.

Header navigation has to be tabbed through again (about 17 Tab presses) to reach Checkout, and there was no remove-item button reachable between quantity and Apply coupon; Clear cart sits right before Checkout, a risky neighbour.

On the checkout Address page the first Tab stops were an unnamed icon link, Sign in and the Address step link before reaching the Email field, and the long form (billing and shipping address) could not be completed in the remaining step budget.
